items.title: Anthropic makes its IPO debut on the Nasdaq: Sozzi hot takes and what to watch
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi gives his take on the Anthropic (ANT) IPO: expectations, numbers, CEO perspectives, and what analysts are saying as the company prepares to trade.

Walmart (WMT) CFO John David Rainey joins the show to chat about the state of the consumer as wealthy shoppers look for bargains while some buyers panic and stock up on certain goods.

items.title: Walmart CFO: 'Value and speed' is the winning combo amid $4 Gas
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) CFO John David Rainey joins Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi and Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma to discuss the company's latest earnings report, crediting value, faster delivery, and early holiday sales running ahead of last year.

items.title: Is Target finally catching up to Walmart?
items.summary:
Walmart (WMT) posted third quarter earnings results that beat Wall Street's expectations. 

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares a few of his thoughts on the print, especially compared with Target's (TGT) recent results.

items.title: Stocks boosted by Anthropic optimism as the company gets set for IPO
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley, tackle the top stories of the day, including Anthropic's (ANT) IPO, which priced its stock at $83. Plus, the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and sales are expected to hit 3 billion dollars. Plus, Walmart (WMT) raised its outlook as wealthier shoppers continue to seek bargains.

items.title: Walmart beats Q3 earnings expectations, raises full-year outlook again
items.summary: The retail giant will give Wall Street key insight ahead of the holiday shopping season.

items.title: Walmart's earnings reveal why it's becoming a tech powerhouse
items.summary:
Walmart (WMT) raised its full-year outlook following stronger-than-expected earnings, fueled in part by its growing e-commerce business and investments in technology.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss Walmart's digital transformation, its expanding partnerships with tech companies, and why investors may want to start thinking of the retail giant as more than just a traditional retailer.
